saw_lines: Robot mower buyers ask what it costs and how it arrives before trusting a machine they cannot test in a shop.
So the sale is lost in the ad, when a buyer cannot see the price or delivery before they click.
Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it. Put the offer in the first line of three new ads and on the creative.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 14 Oct 2026
points: Your site offers subscribe and save, yet 0 of 21 ads mention it. A first buyer has no reason to act today. Open three new ads with subscribe and save in the first line and print it on the creative.

Your site explains shipping, yet 0 of 28 ads mention shipping or delivery. A buyer weighing a robot mower leaves when delivery stays unclear. Put the delivery answer in the first line of three new ads for first time buyers.

Your site has subscribe and save, yet 0 of 28 ads mention a subscription. Each sale ends at checkout, so repeat buyers never hear the saving. Run two ads for Luba 3 AWD owners with subscribe and save as the headline.

Your site shows prices, yet 0 of 28 ads mention price or cost. A buyer comparing a robot mower needs a figure before clicking. Lead one ad with the LUBA 3 AWD price beside the 10,000 square metres it covers.
